tldr: Two endpoint gain curves can appear independent when their true conditional gains lie in one direction. In the full randomized two-endpoint binary-record model, the proved energy-stratified minimax separation-rate surface is \(\rho_n^*(s)\asymp\min\{s,\sqrt s\,n^{-2/5}\}\). One finite original-record Gram test attains this surface without knowing gain energy, direction, or endpoint covariance. Supported binary alternatives establish the converse in every positive shell, with no logarithmic strength-adaptation cost. The \(s\) branch is a minimax-radius saturation statement: its theorem-level upper class is empty, while the lower class is nonempty. The global \(n^{-2/5}\) order is an incremental transfer of inherited testing techniques. Exact uniform leading constants remain open.
gap: Published additive parallelism, pointwise matrix-rank inference, and fixed quadratic-functional testing do not directly give a uniform original-record area-and-energy boundary through shrinking rank one and rank zero. Algebraic reduction to a Gram rank null alone does not verify their inferential assumptions.
